title: OmniDiff JSON output
description: What `omnidiff --mode json BEFORE AFTER` prints: one diff as one JSON object, for editors and tools that place highlights on their own buffers. JSON output is never chosen automatically: only `--mode json` selects it, so a pipe never receives it by surprise. Rows and columns are 0-indexed, and columns are byte offsets within their row, as tree-sitter reports them: Neovim takes them directly, while VS Code and LSP need UTF-16 code units, which a consumer computes per line from the line's text. File contents are not embedded: both paths are real files the caller can open.

large_residual.description: The diff left an unusually large unmatched residual; headless mode prints this to stderr instead.

summary.description: The diff's overall shape, as the TUI's status bar names it. Absent for an ordinary mix of edits.

binary.description: At least one side is binary, so no text diff was computed: both sides' hunks are empty and there is no summary. A flag, because empty hunks alone look like identical files. Absent for a text diff.

content.description: For a binary pair OmniDiff diffs by content (pictures, archives, fonts, cursors, message catalogs, PDFs): what changed in it. Absent otherwise.

picture.description: For a picture pair: the same as `content`, without its `kind`. Kept for consumers written before `content`.

language.description: The language detected from the path (and, for some, the contents); null for plain text. Present for a binary side too, since it describes the file, not the diff.

encoding.description: The file's encoding when it is not UTF-8, from its byte order mark. The hunks are ranges in the UTF-8 text it decodes to.

hunks.description: Every changed range in this side's own file. Unchanged text gets no hunk.

move_target.description: For a move only: where the moved text is in the other file.

reference_line.description: The row of the nearest enclosing named declaration (function, class, struct), when there is one.

range.description: A range from (start_row, start_column) up to, not including, (end_row, end_column).

content.description: A content diff, tagged with its `kind`.

picture.description: Two pictures: what each side is and what changed. A side is null for an added or deleted picture.

picture_info.description: One side of a picture pair, as the file says it is.

format.description: The format the bytes are in, whatever the extension says ("PNG").

color.description: The stored color type ("RGBA8", "L8"): a palette or bit-depth change shows here when the pixels did not change.

frames.description: How many frames an animation has. Absent for a still picture.

duration_ms.description: An animation's running time, its frames' delays added up. Absent for a still picture.

comparison.description: What changed between two pictures, tagged with its `kind`.

oneOf.description: One side is missing (an added or deleted file): nothing to compare.

aspect_kept.description: Both sides have one aspect ratio, to a pixel.

scaled.description: Two still pictures of one aspect ratio, compared at the smaller one's size with the larger scaled down to it, in the smaller one's pixels.

oneOf.description: Animations of the same size (or an animation and a still), compared frame by frame.

steps.description: The aligned frames, in order: runs of frames that look the same, single changed frames, and runs only one side has.

retimed.description: Frames that look the same show for different times.

faint.description: Frames that look the same differ in their pixels nonetheless.

pixels.description: Two pictures of the same size, compared pixel by pixel. No region means no visible change, even if the bytes differ (a re-encoding, a metadata change).

changed_pixels.description: Pixels that pass pixelmatch's test for a visible difference.

regions.description: Where the changed pixels are, largest first.

differing_pixels.description: Pixels that differ at all, fully transparent ones alike whatever their color.

strong_pixels.description: Changed pixels that differ clearly, past pixelmatch's threshold 0.3.

layout_kept.description: The two keep one layout: their coarse brightness patterns correlate.

region.description: A rectangle of changed pixels, in the pixel coordinates both pictures share.

changed_pixels.description: How many of the rectangle's pixels changed.

frame_step.description: One step of an animation diff. Frame numbers count from 0, in each side's own frames.

oneOf.description: `frames` frames that look the same, before's from `before` on and after's from `after` on.
Before's frame `before` became after's frame `after`, with these pixels changed.
`frames` frames only after has, from its frame `after` on.
`frames` frames only before has, from its frame `before` on.

container.description: Two files that hold members (an archive's files, a font's glyphs and tables, a PDF's pages, a catalog's messages, a cursor's sizes): the members that changed, were added or were removed.

unchanged.description: How many members both sides have unchanged; they are not listed.

container_side.description: One side of a container pair; null for an added or deleted file.

format.description: The format the bytes are in ("ZIP", "TAR.GZ").

key.description: What names the member on both sides: a path in an archive, a glyph's code point or name, a page number, a message's context and id.

detail.description: For a changed member: what changed, if it opened.

member_detail.description: What changed in a member both sides have, tagged with its `kind`.

oneOf.description: A member that is content of another kind: an archive in an archive.
Text, compared by lines: how many each side has, and how many only it has.

whitespace.description: When lines changed but only in their whitespace: at their ends only, or anywhere.

words_kept.description: The two sides share at least half their words, counted with repeats: text rewritten rather than replaced.

oneOf.description: Bytes nothing more is known about.
